text:
Maya: Dropped a new compact-canary frame in Figma. Main asks: VoiceOver order for status vs percentage, and behavior when chips wrap on mobile. https://www.figma.com/file/ABC/compact-canary
Priya: VoiceOver currently reads 'Canary C 10%' before status. Status should be announced first. Prefer semantic reorder + CSS for visual parity. Also overflow must be keyboard operable.
Jordan: Reorder fine in DOM; use CSS order to keep visual layout. Overflow as '+N' button that opens a popover works.
Maya: Good. Concern: overflow could push rollback CTA below fold on small heights.
Sam: Keep rollback visible; prefer overflow instead of wrapping. Also let's test CTA copy "Revert" vs "Roll back" in canary.
Luca: I'll add feature flag canary_legend_compact and analytics label copy_variant.
Priya: Accessibility checklist: status early in DOM, aria-describedby from row to status, overflow is button with aria-expanded, focus styles, hidden items aria-hidden. Contrast of critical pills >=4.5:1 in both themes.
deploy-bot: Staging build: https://staging.redwood.ai/deploys/compact-legend
Maya: Thanks — I'll update Figma with DOM notes and a narrow-screen frame for final review.
